findings.message: workflow seal compares both host-supplied live identities before terminal persistence; a separate tracked edit precisely during finalization is not sampled by the CLI.

architecture-health-gate.message: Reviewer reported a post-aggregation VCS identity timing gap; main-agent adjudication treats the precisely timed cross-process race as advisory under the confirmed host-owned VCS boundary, but preserves the raw reviewer result.

findings.message: prompts/reviewer-base.md does not state that shared cross-gate rules take precedence over gate-specific prose, although the confirmed gate-file contract requires it. A normally installed custom gate can therefore conflict with the shared contract without a defined precedence rule.

code-quality-gate.message: The shared reviewer prompt omits a required precedence rule; all executable checks otherwise passed.

complexity-gate.message: The complete Phase 4 change is the simplest sufficient solution; it removes the obsolete evidence subsystem, reuses existing owners, and leaves no redundant subsystem, registry, adapter, compatibility path, or unnecessary public surface.

cases.procedure: Installed disposable packages and exercised catalog add, remove, overlay, invalid filename, empty content, and invalid UTF-8.
cases.observation: Expected lexical catalog was preserved, reinstall add and remove were exact, overlay was ignored, and invalid gates failed before dispatch.

cases.procedure: Prepared the same gate twice and exercised missing or invalid base and gate prompts.
cases.observation: Payloads were identical with each prompt once, state stayed PENDING, no override or agent runtime appeared, and invalid inputs produced no payload.

cases.procedure: Interrupted before recording, resumed and redispatched, concurrently recorded gate results, aborted, and attempted a late write.
cases.observation: PENDING was preserved, concurrent writes survived, only state.json existed, abort cleaned the run, and late write failed.

cases.procedure: Recorded semantic results, changed the requirement, then changed an installed catalog in a separate run and resumed.
cases.observation: Requirement change cleared dependent state and catalog change required a new run.

cases.procedure: Created three cases and recorded PASS, ordinary FAIL, and PASS evidence.
cases.observation: All cases executed with complete fields, aggregate became FAIL, and no removed approval artifacts existed.

cases.procedure: Tracked new files before edits, captured Git trees, compared them, exercised bad identity and no-VCS start.
cases.observation: Both files appeared in native diff, state stored identities only, bad identity became runtime error, and no-VCS start failed.

cases.procedure: Prepared QA and all gates concurrently, recorded all results concurrently, and tested targeted and unknown gate selection.
cases.observation: Bindings matched, all writes survived, selected output contained one gate, and unknown gate failed before output.

cases.procedure: Executed two tracked repair cycles with QA reruns, complete Carry decisions, rerun and inheritance.
cases.observation: QA reset each time, Carry covered each prior PASS once, rerun gates were fresh, and inheritance used only the immediate source.

cases.procedure: Attempted incomplete, supplied-identity-changing, and unchanged-complete seals.
cases.observation: Incomplete and differing-identity attempts were rejected; unchanged complete seal retained a summary and cleaned temporary state.
cases.oracleResult: PASS: documented seal inputs and cleanup matched.

cases.procedure: Installed the exact package for Claude, Codex, and Cursor, validated each, ran portable canaries, and checked host paths.
cases.observation: Core package hashes matched, host hooks stayed separate, and all validation and canary checks passed.
